SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO FROM KEPPRHD WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY QUOTATION_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KBPO' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(REVISION_NO,' ') AS REVISION, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, NVL(REQ_USER_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, NVL(REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, NVL(REQ_USER_MAIL,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, NVL(CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(CLOSE_TIME,' ') AS CLOSE_TIME, NVL(ITEM_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEPPRHD WHERE 1=1 AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ
UPDATE KEPPRHD SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
